mapper.insert: INSERT INTO xsy_trace_lot (lot_no, source_lot_no, supplier_id, sku_id, origin_type, first_receipt_item_id, created_by) VALUES (#{lotNo}, #{sourceLotNo}, #{supplierId}, #{skuId}, #{originType}, #{firstReceiptItemId}, #{createdBy})
INSERT INTO xsy_purchase_receipt_item_lot (purchase_receipt_item_id, lot_id, quantity, created_by) VALUES (#{receiptItemId}, #{lotId}, #{quantity}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT l.purchase_receipt_item_id AS receiptItemId, l.lot_id AS lotId, t.lot_no AS lotNo, t.source_lot_no AS sourceLotNo, l.quantity AS quantity FROM xsy_purchase_receipt_item_lot l JOIN xsy_trace_lot t ON t.id = l.lot_id WHERE l.purchase_receipt_item_id IN #{id} ORDER BY l.purchase_receipt_item_id, l.id
